requirements.implementation_scope: Actual finite structural role graph worklist and full supplied raw-axiom closure. Exact byte identity/orientation, duplicates, cycles and first forbidden required occurrence are covered. The raw collector is proved to supply every reached node; missing-node outcomes are impossible at the raw entry points. Only the simple-role restriction is decided. Imported closure assembly, chain regularity, datatype/anonymous/global restrictions and full DL validation remain separate.

requirements.requirement: RoleHierarchyRegularity
requirements.implementation_scope: Full raw-axiom property-hierarchy regularity condition from the 2012 Structural Specification §11.2. Original byte IRI identity and orientation; all ordered chains; top-property exemption, exact two-role transitivity, endpoint recursion, global transitivity and the literal inverse-source condition; inverse-source closure applies to direct targets, without assumed inverse-target invariance. The full finite worklist terminates without fuel. Raw node completeness excludes missing outcomes. Successful concrete relation is a strict order compatible with reverse hierarchy reachability; a rejected forced pair is contained in every permitted ordering. Canonical import assembly and all other DL restrictions remain separate.

requirements.requirement: DatatypeDefinitionAcyclicity
requirements.implementation_scope: Actual supplied complete raw axiom closure and exact IRI byte identity. The proved range collector derives every typed datatype dependency from all six range forms, including literal datatypes in enumerations/facet values; enclosing axiom annotations and untyped facet IRIs add no dependency. Directed reflexive reachability restores its owned input and is total even on repeated/cyclic finite graphs. Incremental checking accepts iff a strict partial order exists on the actual datatype carrier and includes every required smaller-to-defined pair. A rejected original dependency has a reverse path and proves no such order can exist. Nonempty transitive reachability constructs the mathematical order witness. No heuristic fuel or caller node metadata is assumed; this correctness-first graph search may take exponential time. Definition availability/uniqueness is separately proved and composed below; custom datatype literal/restriction positions, normative lexical/facet/value spaces, canonical imports, physical resources and complete DL validation remain separate obligations.

requirements.implementation_scope: Complete standard unary raw OWL language: all 18 class forms, six data ranges and 37 annotated axiom variants. Unordered minimum-two associations count recursive structural equivalence classes, including cardinality omission defaults; required nonempty associations, ordered chain minimum written arity, unary data quantifiers and natural numbers follow from raw types. The explicitly accepted 2014 duplicate-disjointness compatibility rule requires pairwise different original members for DisjointClasses, DisjointUnion member classes, disjoint object/data properties and DifferentIndividuals; this is not an amendment to the 2012 Recommendation. Ordinary association repetitions are retained when two distinct members remain; ordered property chains may repeat. The full recursive closure operation composes these rules with the proved nonempty-key check, is total, accepts iff the independent conjunction holds and preserves the first original annotated failure. Input bytes, lexical/facet/value validity, canonical output, RDF self-disjointness mapping, import scoping and complete DL/reasoning validation remain separate.

requirements.requirement: Functional Syntax complete quoted payload component: escape_total_correct
requirements.implementation_scope: Actual Functional Syntax quoted-string payload reading is now proved total and accepts exactly the independent delimited raw-XML/two-escape byte grammar within the decoded-output byte budget. Opening/closing punctuation, raw multiline Unicode, escaped quote/backslash, canonical encoded-unit concatenation, strict source progress and first original-unit diagnostics are composed without trusting lexer metadata. Every malformed UTF-8, missing unit, wrong raw XML character, foreign escape and budget failure has a grammar/phase-specific specification. Both directions connect the decoded-token grammar with the independently verified complete quoted-string terminal language; every matching source candidate has a payload and a fitting budget guarantees the actual exact payload/end result. The reader stops at the closing quote and does not validate a later source suffix; whole-suffix validation is provided by the separate terminal selector. The separately proved stream lexer composes separators/trivia. Other payload kinds, document parsing/import scopes and OWL decisions remain pending. Physical allocation/stack and cancellation remain separate M8 obligations.

requirements.requirement: Verified ALC concept satisfiability without a TBox: toList_fromList
requirements.implementation_scope: Actual ALC concept-satisfiability procedure in the kernel, without a TBox: it decides whether some interpretation has an element in a negation-normal-form concept. Conjunctions are expanded, disjunctions branch, top is dropped and bottom rejects; once only named-class literals and restrictions remain, a named class occurring both positively and negated is a clash, and every existential restriction is decided recursively together with the universal restrictions on the same property, with properties and classes compared by exact IRI spelling. The procedure is proved total by well-founded recursion on the lexicographic pair of the total and the pending concept size. It is proved sound: every acceptance yields an explicit tree interpretation over paths whose root satisfies the concept, built from the successor models of the existential restrictions. It is proved complete: any interpretation in any universe with an element in the concept forces acceptance. Composed with the proved negation-normal-form translation, the tableau never rejects an OWL class expression with an instance in an OWL interpretation, so every rejection proves the expression empty in every OWL interpretation, which justifies unsatisfiability and subsumption answers for the ALC fragment. This is an internal fragment experiment toward M6: TBox axioms and blocking, the remaining SROIQ constructors, datatypes, the OWL-level tree model fixing owl:Thing and owl:Nothing, ontology-level query reductions and performance remain pending. No source/extraction assumption, admitted claim or custom semantic axiom is introduced.

The procedure is proved total by well-founded recursion on the lexicographic pair of the total and the pending concept size. It is proved sound: every acceptance yields an explicit tree interpretation over paths whose root satisfies the concept, built from the successor models of the existential restrictions. It is proved complete: any interpretation in any universe with an element in the concept forces acceptance. Composed with the proved negation-normal-form translation, the tableau never rejects an OWL class expression with an instance in an OWL interpretation, so every rejection proves the expression empty in every OWL interpretation, which justifies unsatisfiability and subsumption answers for the ALC fragment. requirements.requirement: Verified ALC concept satisfiability with respect to a TBox, with blocking: sat_mono
requirements.implementation_scope: Actual ALC concept-satisfiability procedure with respect to a TBox in the kernel: it decides whether some interpretation in which a negation-normal-form TBox concept holds at every element has an element in a negation-normal-form concept (general concept inclusions C ⊑ D can be supplied as the negation normal form of the conjunction of the unions of the complement of C with D). It runs the rules of the plain tableau, adds the TBox concept at the root and at every successor, and blocks, and accepts, a node whose literal set is contained in the literal set of an ancestor on its branch; concepts are compared structurally by exact IRI spelling. It is proved total by well-founded recursion on the lexicographic triple of the remaining room 2^|closure| - |ancestors|, the total concept size and the pending concept size: every unblocked node adds a literal set from the finite subconcept closure of the input and TBox concepts that differs from all of its ancestors' sets, which bounds every branch. It is proved sound through a Hintikka-family certificate: every acceptance yields a finite family of clash-free literal sets that each satisfy the TBox concept, with every existential restriction witnessed inside the family together with the universal restrictions on its property, and the interpretation whose elements are those sets is a model of the TBox concept with an instance of the input concept. It is proved complete: any interpretation in any universe in which the TBox concept holds everywhere and the input concept has an instance forces acceptance. Composed with the proved negation-normal-form translation, the procedure never rejects an OWL class expression with an instance in an OWL interpretation in which the TBox class expression holds at every element, so every rejection proves the expression empty in all such interpretations. This is an internal fragment experiment toward M6: reading ontology axioms into the TBox class expression, the OWL-level model fixing owl:Thing and owl:Nothing, the remaining SROIQ constructors and role axioms, datatypes, ontology-level query reductions and performance remain pending. No source/extraction assumption, admitted claim or custom semantic axiom is introduced.

requirements.requirement: Verified ontology-level ALC consistency, class satisfiability, subsumption and instance checking: all_equal_iff
requirements.implementation_scope: Actual ontology-level ALC reasoning in the kernel with assertions about individuals: consistency, class satisfiability, subsumption and instance checking with respect to an axiom closure. Every supported class axiom is internalized into a negation-normal-form concept that holds at every element exactly when the axiom holds: SubClassOf(C D) becomes the union of the complement of C with D, EquivalentClasses holds all members together or none, DisjointClasses excludes every two member occurrences, DisjointUnion also equates the class with the union of its members, ObjectPropertyDomain and ObjectPropertyRange on a named object property restrict its sources or targets, and declarations, annotation axioms and assertions impose nothing; the closure's TBox concept is their conjunction, proved to hold at every element exactly when an interpretation fixing owl:Thing and owl:Nothing satisfies every axiom that is not an assertion. Every individual that an assertion mentions gets a node, interned by exact structural equality, and node 0 stands for one further element. ClassAssertion becomes the translated concept at its individual's node, ObjectPropertyAssertion an edge along its named property (an inverse property reverses it), and a NegativeObjectPropertyAssertion contradicts the closure exactly when the same edge is asserted. The queries add their concepts at node 0 or at the queried individual's node and decide with the verified completion for named individuals. They answer exactly when the internalization and all translations succeed, no translated concept uses a built-in object property as a role or a built-in class as an ordinary named class, no assertion uses a built-in object property, and there is room for the nodes and placed concepts. Each answer is proved to equal the independent Direct Semantics definitions of Consistent, ClassSatisfiable, Subsumed and InstanceOf for any valid vocabulary: every acceptance is turned into an actual OWL model of the closure, built from the completion's model with every individual at its node, the built-in classes and object and data properties fixed and data values, datatypes, literals and facets taken from the datatype map, and every OWL model, in any universe and with any reinterpretation of its anonymous individuals, forces acceptance. SameIndividual, DifferentIndividuals, data assertions, the other axiom forms, the remaining SROIQ constructors and role axioms, datatypes, query answering and performance remain pending. No source/extraction assumption, admitted claim or custom semantic axiom is introduced.

Every supported class axiom is internalized into a negation-normal-form concept that holds at every element exactly when the axiom holds: SubClassOf(C D) becomes the union of the complement of C with D, EquivalentClasses holds all members together or none, DisjointClasses excludes every two member occurrences, DisjointUnion also equates the class with the union of its members, ObjectPropertyDomain and ObjectPropertyRange on a named object property restrict its sources or targets, and declarations, annotation axioms and assertions impose nothing; the closure's TBox concept is their conjunction, proved to hold at every element exactly when an interpretation fixing owl:Thing and owl:Nothing satisfies every axiom that is not an assertion. Every individual that an assertion mentions gets a node, interned by exact structural equality, and node 0 stands for one further element. ClassAssertion becomes the translated concept at its individual's node, ObjectPropertyAssertion an edge along its named property (an inverse property reverses it), and a NegativeObjectPropertyAssertion contradicts the closure exactly when the same edge is asserted. The queries add their concepts at node 0 or at the queried individual's node and decide with the verified completion for named individuals. They answer exactly when the internalization and all translations succeed, no translated concept uses a built-in object property as a role or a built-in class as an ordinary named class, no assertion uses a built-in object property, and there is room for the nodes and placed concepts. Each answer is proved to equal the independent Direct Semantics definitions of Consistent, ClassSatisfiable, Subsumed and InstanceOf for any valid vocabulary: every acceptance is turned into an actual OWL model of the closure, built from the completion's model with every individual at its node, the built-in classes and object and data properties fixed and data values, datatypes, literals and facets taken from the datatype map, and every OWL model, in any universe and with any reinterpretation of its anonymous individuals, forces acceptance. SameIndividual, DifferentIndividuals, data assertions, the other axiom forms, the remaining SROIQ constructors and role axioms, datatypes, query answering and performance remain pending. No source/extraction assumption, admitted claim or custom semantic axiom is introduced.

Every supported class axiom is internalized into a negation-normal-form concept that holds at every element exactly when the axiom holds: SubClassOf(C D) becomes the union of the complement of C with D, EquivalentClasses holds all members together or none, DisjointClasses excludes every two member occurrences, DisjointUnion also equates the class with the union of its members, ObjectPropertyDomain and ObjectPropertyRange on a named object property restrict its sources or targets, and declarations, annotation axioms and assertions impose nothing; the closure's TBox concept is their conjunction, proved to hold at every element exactly when an interpretation fixing owl:Thing and owl:Nothing satisfies every axiom that is not an assertion. Every individual that an assertion mentions gets a node, interned by exact structural equality, and node 0 stands for one further element. ClassAssertion becomes the translated concept at its individual's node, ObjectPropertyAssertion an edge along its named property (an inverse property reverses it), and a NegativeObjectPropertyAssertion contradicts the closure exactly when the same edge is asserted. The queries add their concepts at node 0 or at the queried individual's node and decide with the verified completion for named individuals. They answer exactly when the internalization and all translations succeed, no translated concept uses a built-in object property as a role or a built-in class as an ordinary named class, no assertion uses a built-in object property, and there is room for the nodes and placed concepts. Each answer is proved to equal the independent Direct Semantics definitions of Consistent, ClassSatisfiable, Subsumed and InstanceOf for any valid vocabulary: every acceptance is turned into an actual OWL model of the closure, built from the completion's model with every individual at its node, the built-in classes and object and data properties fixed and data values, datatypes, literals and facets taken from the datatype map, and every OWL model, in any universe and with any reinterpretation of its anonymous individuals, forces acceptance. SameIndividual, DifferentIndividuals, data assertions, the other axiom forms, the remaining SROIQ constructors and role axioms, datatypes, query answering and performance remain pending. No source/extraction assumption, admitted claim or custom semantic axiom is introduced.

Every supported class axiom is internalized into a negation-normal-form concept that holds at every element exactly when the axiom holds: SubClassOf(C D) becomes the union of the complement of C with D, EquivalentClasses holds all members together or none, DisjointClasses excludes every two member occurrences, DisjointUnion also equates the class with the union of its members, ObjectPropertyDomain and ObjectPropertyRange on a named object property restrict its sources or targets, and declarations, annotation axioms and assertions impose nothing; the closure's TBox concept is their conjunction, proved to hold at every element exactly when an interpretation fixing owl:Thing and owl:Nothing satisfies every axiom that is not an assertion. Every individual that an assertion mentions gets a node, interned by exact structural equality, and node 0 stands for one further element. ClassAssertion becomes the translated concept at its individual's node, ObjectPropertyAssertion an edge along its named property (an inverse property reverses it), and a NegativeObjectPropertyAssertion contradicts the closure exactly when the same edge is asserted. The queries add their concepts at node 0 or at the queried individual's node and decide with the verified completion for named individuals. They answer exactly when the internalization and all translations succeed, no translated concept uses a built-in object property as a role or a built-in class as an ordinary named class, no assertion uses a built-in object property, and there is room for the nodes and placed concepts. Each answer is proved to equal the independent Direct Semantics definitions of Consistent, ClassSatisfiable, Subsumed and InstanceOf for any valid vocabulary: every acceptance is turned into an actual OWL model of the closure, built from the completion's model with every individual at its node, the built-in classes and object and data properties fixed and data values, datatypes, literals and facets taken from the datatype map, and every OWL model, in any universe and with any reinterpretation of its anonymous individuals, forces acceptance. SameIndividual, DifferentIndividuals, data assertions, the other axiom forms, the remaining SROIQ constructors and role axioms, datatypes, query answering and performance remain pending. No source/extraction assumption, admitted claim or custom semantic axiom is introduced.

requirements.requirement: Class keyword total correct for exact source class-expression reading
requirements.implementation_scope: Actual Functional Syntax class-expression reading for the reasoner's ALC fragment is total and has complete exact result/error equivalence. It reads one class expression at a caller-supplied position: a named class IRI, ObjectIntersectionOf and ObjectUnionOf with at least two members, ObjectComplementOf, and ObjectSomeValuesFrom and ObjectAllValuesFrom over an object property expression, which is an IRI or ObjectInverseOf( IRI ). The other twelve class-expression forms are reported as unsupported at their keyword. Every IRI resolves its original span through the checked prefix table under the iri limit. Errors return the first failing step in source order with original offsets (EOF errors use the source length): at a connective keyword the nesting depth, then the opening parenthesis, then the operands in order, where each member of an intersection or union follows the member-count check, then the two-member minimum, then the closing parenthesis. The independent grammar is a mutually recursive derivation of class expressions, connective bodies and member sequences. The reader is proved total by well-founded recursion on the token count; every result and first error has its derivation, and every derivation is the actual result. A successful expression consumes at least one token and returns the unchanged suffix. Original-byte prefix parsing and normative checked-table construction compose with the reader using precisely those source namespace rows. Class expressions are source records: the mapping into the kernel's model belongs to document construction, and the remaining class-expression forms, data ranges and individuals are later stages. No source/extraction assumption, admitted claim or custom semantic axiom is introduced.

requirements.requirement: Verified ALC reasoning with named individuals: targetsOf_mem
requirements.implementation_scope: Actual ALC reasoning with named individuals in the kernel: abox_satisfiable decides whether some interpretation in which a negation-normal-form TBox concept holds at every element has an element for every node below a positive count that satisfies the given facts (concepts at nodes) and edges (named object properties between nodes). The completion adds the TBox concept at every node, then adds each fact once: it expands conjunctions, branches on disjunctions and pushes the filler of every universal restriction to the target of every edge of its role from the node. Once no fact is pending it checks every node for a clash and decides every existential restriction with the TBox tableau, together with the fillers of the universal restrictions on its role at the same node. Termination is proved from the measure (node-closure pairs not yet added, pending facts). Every acceptance yields an explicit model: one element per node and a disjoint copy of a successor model for every existential obligation, relating node elements only along the given edges; every model in any universe forces acceptance. Equality between individuals, inverse roles, number restrictions and nominals remain pending. No source/extraction assumption, admitted claim or custom semantic axiom is introduced.
